name: custtoolset_pillar9_extractor
description: Executes security and compliance audits, extracting the Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) matrix for SoD analysis, hunting for login anomalies, and verifying MFA on privileged accounts.

analysisType.description: The specific security dataset to extract. Use 'role_permissions' for Segregation of Duties mapping, 'access_anomalies' for brute-force and token spoofing checks, or 'mfa_adherence' to audit Administrator accounts.

returns.description: A JSON payload containing user role configurations, failed login logs with IP addresses, or lists of highly privileged users.
